- Initial release of the "W酒店查询与预订" skill for searching and booking W Hotels in China.
- Supports hotel search with real-time prices and direct booking links, using data from Fliggy’s official Marriott zone.
- Enables hotel detail queries, including amenities and room types based on script-provided data.
- Allows searching for special packages and deals at W Hotels.
- Strict data handling rules to ensure all information and links come directly from the source, with zero fabrication or data enhancement.
